sources.title: Star Cluster Game Concept v0.7e
sources.use: Authoritative research philosophy, current Power model, mixed-TL/legacy rules and Precursor boundary.

sources.title: Expanded Spacedock reference-mining corpus
sources.use: Qualitative progression, weapon identity, power/storage/thermal separation, sensors/EW, missiles/PDS, Damage Control, FTL topology, stealth and exotic-tech candidates.

sources.title: Checkpoint 23 reference mining and design reconciliation
sources.use: Broad-category research, miniaturization, qualitative milestones, separate STL/FTL, KISS/originality guardrails.

sources.title: Master of Orion II manual
sources.use: Pattern inspiration only: research fields with multiple applications, qualitative unlocks and later miniaturization. No names/tables/ladders copied.

sources.title: GURPS Space 4e
sources.use: Pattern inspiration only: “taxonomy of miracles,” grounded-vs-superscience tone, drive/gravity/force-field/exotic-resource questions. No mechanics copied.

sources.title: Terra Invicta Official Wiki - Technology / Tech List
sources.use: Inspiration for enabling-science webs, multiple engineering applications, lower-SF material/computing/power branches. No exact tree/names/stats copied.

sources.title: Terra Invicta Official Wiki - Power Plant List / Advanced Fission Systems
sources.use: Inspiration that fission/fusion can have parallel specialist architectures and that mature older reactor principles can receive later engineering revivals.

sources.title: Terra Invicta Official Wiki - Carbon Nanotubes / Superalloys / Advanced Superconductors
sources.use: Inspiration for cross-pollinating material breakthroughs affecting structure, armor, containment, thermal and electromagnetic systems.

sources.title: Terra Invicta Official Wiki - Supercapacitors
sources.use: Inspiration for storage/discharge-rate progression distinct from sustained generation.

sources.title: Terra Invicta Official Wiki - Advanced Heat Management Concepts
sources.use: Inspiration for compact radiators and thermal engineering as enabling/support tech rather than a combat heat spreadsheet.

sources.title: Terra Invicta Official Wiki - Photonic Computing / Quantum Computing
sources.use: Inspiration for qualitative computing-principle changes rather than simple processor-level scaling.

sources.title: NASA Space Nuclear Propulsion
sources.use: Grounding for fission specialist propulsion branches and mission-dependent tradeoffs between nuclear thermal and nuclear electric propulsion.

sources.title: NASA Solar Electric Propulsion
sources.use: Grounding for efficient low-thrust electric/ion propulsion as specialist lower-SF technology.

sources.title: NASA Fusion Driven Rocket concept
sources.use: Conceptual grounding for Fusion/propulsion cross-pollination and direct-energy conversion as an architecture rather than merely a bigger reactor number.

sources.title: Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory - Fusion Ignition
sources.use: Grounding that controlled fusion is an extreme integration/engineering frontier, supporting Early -> Mature -> High-output Fusion story beats.

sources.title: CERN - Antimatter
sources.use: Grounding for antimatter’s extraordinary energy density plus severe production, vacuum, magnetic containment and handling constraints.

sources.title: Miguel Alcubierre - The warp drive: hyper-fast travel within general relativity
sources.use: Exotic/high-SF inspiration only; the paper itself requires exotic matter. Not evidence that a practical warp drive exists.

sources.title: Crane & Westmoreland - Are Black Hole Starships Possible
sources.use: Exotic/Precursor inspiration for artificial-singularity power/propulsion/weapons; explicitly edge-of-possibility theory, not normal technology.
